channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Vessel hit by ‘unknown projectile’ in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
item.description: British maritime agency says the incident caused one casualty and damaged the vessel's engine room.

item.title: Trump says N Korea’s Kim has responded to his request for a conversation
item.description: US president says conversations with Kim Jong Un at a 'positive' stage and slams Seoul for refusing to join war on Iran.

item.title: Two students killed in Philippine school shooting
item.description: Mayor Khymer Adan Olaso says the casualties in Zamboanga were both students and included the gunman.

item.title: Iran war live: Vessel struck in Strait of Hormuz, crew member injured
item.description: A vessel was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, leaving a crew member injured, according to the UKMTO.

item.title: ‘We will not allow Gaza to be rebuilt’ until Hamas disarms, Kushner says
item.description: Trump's son-in-law and envoy says US will not 'restrict Israel's right to defend itself' as strikes on Gaza continue.

item.title: Trump says Iran will not make the deal he believes is necessary
item.description: Trump says Iran will not make the deal he believes is necessary

item.title: Trump’s approval rating sinks to new low at 33 percent
item.description: New poll found a majority of US citizens concerned about the US war on Iran.

item.title: Photos: Indonesia earthquake rescue efforts continue as death toll hits 68
item.description: At least 68 killed in eastern Indonesia as aftershocks and landslides hamper aid.

item.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
item.description: Trump's threat on Oman, which has been holding its own talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, comes as a 60-day window for peace negotiations expires.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes
item.description: Moscow says nine people have been killed in the past 24 hours, while Kyiv reports four deaths.
